app.connectGarmin: Connect your Garmin account to start syncing your activities, sleep and health data.
app.garminAttention: Your Garmin connection needs attention — open Settings to fix it.
app.importingRecent: Importing your latest Garmin data — your charts fill in within a minute or two.
app.noDataInRange: No data in this period — pick a longer range.

auth.signInToAccount: Sign in with your Quarc account
auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.needsConnection: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accountHint: Your Quarc account is shared with all Quarc apps. Change your password in Quarc Store or Quarc Music.

garmin.title: Garmin Connect
garmin.hint: Sign in with your Garmin Connect account. Quarc Sport checks it with Garmin right away; it is then stored encrypted and only used to fetch your data.
garmin.justConnected: Connected! Your import has started — the latest month first, then your older history.
garmin.codeSent: Garmin sent you a verification code. Enter it here:
garmin.codeSentEmail: Garmin sent a verification code to your email. Enter it here:
garmin.codeSentPhone: Garmin sent a verification code to your phone. Enter it here:
garmin.removeConfirm: Disconnect Garmin? Syncing stops; the data already imported stays.

state.firstImport: Importing your latest month — this usually takes a minute or two.
state.needsCode: Garmin is asking for a new verification code.
state.authFailed: Garmin no longer accepts your saved login (did the password change?). Enter it again.
state.error: Couldn't reach Garmin. Trying again automatically {{when}}.
state.errorSoon: Couldn't reach Garmin. Trying again shortly.

errors.invalid_credentials: Garmin didn't accept this email and password. Check them and try again.
errors.invalid_code: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
errors.code_expired: The verification step expired. Please connect again.
errors.rate_limited: Garmin is limiting sign-ins right now. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many tries. To protect your Garmin account, wait 15 minutes before trying again.
errors.garmin_unreachable: Couldn't reach Garmin. Try again in a moment.
errors.missing_fields: Enter your Garmin email and password.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

strava.hint: Your activities from Strava. Strava has no sleep or daily health data, so only activities appear — shown on their own, never mixed with another source.
strava.notConfigured: Strava isn't set up on this server yet. The server owner adds a Strava API application first (see the README).
strava.waiting: Finish in the Strava page that just opened, then come back here.
strava.privacy: You choose on Strava what to allow. You can disconnect at any time.
strava.importing: Importing your Strava activities, newest first… {{count}} so far.
strava.rateLimited: Waiting for Strava's rate limit — continues {{when}}.
strava.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Strava? The Strava activities stored here are deleted too (Strava asks for that). Your Strava account itself is not touched.
strava.authFailed: Strava no longer allows access (it was revoked or expired). Connect again to continue.
strava.temporaryError: Strava could not be reached just now. It will try again by itself.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.not_configured: Strava isn't set up on this server yet.
errors.no_public_url: This server doesn't know its own address yet (PUBLIC_URL).

updates.title: App updates
updates.noRelease: No release has been published yet.

bodyBatteryDelta.title: Body Battery Recovery (High − Low)
bodyBatteryDelta.hint: How many points you recharged each day. Higher = better recovery. Overlaid with daily stress.

hrRange.title: Daily Heart Rate Range
hrRange.hint: Shaded area = full daily range (min → max). Lines: resting HR (red), daily max 7-day avg (orange).

hrv.title: HRV (Heart Rate Variability)
hrv.empty: No HRV data available. HRV is recorded during deep sleep — ensure your watch is worn while sleeping.
hrv.hint: Higher HRV = better recovery and readiness. Shaded band shows normal variation range.

rollingHr.title: Resting HR — Rolling 7-day Mean ± 1σ
rollingHr.hint: Shaded band = mean ± 1 standard deviation. Narrower band = more consistent HR.

sleepDebt.title: Sleep Duration & Cumulative Debt
sleepDebt.hint: Target: {{hours}}h/night. Cumulative debt = running total of minutes under target (rising = building debt).

sleepSchedule.title: Sleep Schedule Consistency
sleepSchedule.hint: Filled area = sleep window each night (bedtime → wake). Consistent schedule = uniform band height and position.

stepsRolling.title: Steps — Rolling 7-day Mean ± 1σ
stepsRolling.hint: Shaded band = ±1σ. Orange dashed line = long-term trend.

pace.title: Running Pace Trend
pace.hint: Each dot = one run · line = 5-run rolling average · lower = faster

countries.title: Countries
countries.summary: {{count}} countries · {{km}} total · click a row to expand
countries.summary_one: {{count}} country · {{km}} total · click a row to expand

fastestPace.title: All Runs — by Pace (fastest first)
fastestPace.subtitle: Only runs longer than 2 km · lower pace = faster

longestRide.title: All Rides — by Distance
longestRide.subtitle: {{count}} cycling activities sorted longest to shortest

fastestRide.title: All Rides — by Avg Speed (fastest first)
fastestRide.subtitle: {{count}} cycling activities

bestTe.title: All Activities — by Aerobic Training Effect
bestTe.subtitle: Higher = more aerobic stress. Max is 5.0

maxHr.title: All Activities — by Max Heart Rate
maxHr.subtitle: {{count}} activities with HR data

maxSteps.title: All Days — by Step Count
maxSteps.subtitle: {{count}} days with step data · top 200 shown

maxDailyDist.title: All Days — by Total Distance
maxDailyDist.subtitle: {{count}} days with distance data · top 200 shown

highBb.title: All Days — by Peak Body Battery
highBb.subtitle: {{count}} days · higher = more recovered

lowestRhr.title: All Days — by Resting Heart Rate (lowest first)
lowestRhr.subtitle: Lower = more recovered / better fitness

pb.title: Personal Bests
pb.clickCard: click any card to see full list
pb.footerMap: {{count}} entries · click a row to highlight on map · click outside to close

map.title: Activity Map
